election_dates.primarySnippet: Tex. Elec. Code § 41.007(a): The general primary election date is the first Tuesday in March in each even-numbered year.
election_dates.generalSnippet: Tex. Elec. Code § 41.002: The general election for state and county officers shall be held on the first Tuesday after the first Monday in November in even-numbered years.

state_background_check.value: No — Texas's felony-disqualification requirement (Tex. Elec. Code § 141.001(a)(4)) applies only to "a public elective office in this state" by its own text, not federal office; separately, the U.S. Constitution's own qualifications for Congress (age, citizenship, residency) can't be added to by any state, so this doesn't reach U.S. House or Senate candidates either way
state_background_check.snippet: Tex. Elec. Code § 141.001: "(a) To be eligible to be a candidate for, or elected or appointed to, a public elective office in this state, a person must: ... (4) have not been finally convicted of a felony from which the person has not been pardoned or otherwise released from the resulting disabilities..." Congressional qualifications are set exclusively by the U.S. Constitution, confirmed per https://www.everycrsreport.com/reports/R41946.html: "the Framers intended the Constitution to be the exclusive source of qualifications for Members of Congress, and that the Framers thereby 'divested' States of any power to add qualifications."

platform.value: Committed to working with local leaders to make property taxes more affordable for El Paso residents, addressing high property taxes caused by excessive school budgets and PR Bonds
platform.snippet: El Paso's property taxes are among the highest in Texas, and it's time for a change. El Pasoan's deserve better than to struggle under the weight of inflated property taxes by excessive school budgets and P R Bonds(Cashless Bail). I am committed to working with local leaders to make our property taxes more affordable for everyone in our community.

platform.value: Committed to supporting Customs and Border Protection mission to protect the border and keep El Paso safe, preventing criminals and narcotics from crossing
platform.snippet: A secure border is essential for maintaining safety and stability within El Paso. It helps prevent criminals and narcotics from crossing our border and doing harm to El Pasoan's. Having served a career in the U.S Border Patrol as part of the Border Patrol Tactical Team, or BORTAC, I have seen first hand how many criminals are apprehended and amount of narcotics that are seized. I am committed to supporting the Custom's and Border Protection mission to protect our border and keep El Paso safe.

platform.value: Dedicated to ensure Veterans receive the care they deserve, cutting red tape that delays benefits, and expanding job and training opportunities
platform.snippet: I am dedicated to ensure our Veterans receive the care they deserve, cutting the red tape that delays benefits, expanding job and training opportunities.

platform.value: Fully supports enacting changes to ensure Social Security remains in place but opposes raising the minimum age limit to receive benefits
platform.snippet: I fully support enacting changes that will ensure Social Security remains in place, however, raising the minimum age limit to receive these benefits is not one of them. We need to enact common sense legislation that doesnt include making Seniors wait even longer to receive the benefits that they deserve.

platform.value: Committed to working to reduce the cost of insurance premiums and make insurance more affordable without federal government subsidizing costs, addressing the issue of younger populations paying higher premiums to cover other groups
platform.snippet: In Congress, we must work to make the cost more affordable so that one group of the population isn't paying more in premiums to cover the other. I am committed to working with other leaders to find a solution that will reduce the cost of insurance premiums and make insurance more affordable without the federal government subsidizing these costs.

platform.value: Committed to provide support for women only sports and women only restrooms, opposing biological men competing in women's sports or using women's restrooms
platform.snippet: Biological men have no business competing in women's sports and should not be allowed to use the women's restroom. I am committed to provide support for women only sports and women only restrooms, anything less is irresponsible.

enacted_laws.title: Servicemembers and Veterans Initiative Act of 2020
enacted_laws.summary: Servicemembers and Veterans Initiative Act of 2020 This bill establishes the Servicemembers and Veterans Initiative within the Civil Rights Division of the Department of Justice (DOJ). The initiative shall serve as legal and policy advisor on DOJ's efforts to enforce criminal and civil laws that impact service members, veterans, and their families; develop policy recommendations for improved enforcement of federal law to support service members, veterans, and their families; serve as the liaison and point of contact between DOJ and the military departments; provide counsel for the Office of Justice Programs to ensure that funding decisions take into account service members, veterans, and their families; serve as a liaison and point of contact with the Consumer Protection Branch of DOJ's Civil Division with respect to the prosecution of federal crimes involving fraud that target service members; and serve as a liaison and point of contact with other DOJ components as needed to support the enforcement of other federal laws that protect service members and veterans.
